name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-styled-rex-and-banzai-bomber-bill-pack
title: Alternate Redrawn Styled Rex and Banzai/Bomber Bill Pack
description:
Alternate redrawn-style graphics meant for Rex and the Banzai/Bomber Bill enemies seen in the very first - number-wise - stage of Super Mario World. Rex takes cues from both its last modern appearance - Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga DX - and Mario's Lost World, while Banzai/Bomber Bill is inspired on its modern look from NSMB onwards.

The pack includes a few variations for Rex based on their eyes, as well includes graphics for Arinsu's Sliding Rex and Russian Man's Spittin' Rex custom sprites.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.
